description: Header file defining structures, function prototypes, and constants for LWM2M observation handling in a networked device, including observer notification, attribute management, and path list operations.

classes.name: observe_node
classes.description: Structure representing an observation node, including list linkage, path list, token, timestamps, notification state, and resource flags.

classes.name: lwm2m_attr
classes.description: Opaque structure representing an attribute associated with LWM2M objects.

classes.name: lwm2m_obj_path_list
classes.description: Structure for a list node containing a LWM2M object path.

methods.name: lwm2m_notify_observer
methods.description: Notify an observer identified by object and resource IDs.

methods.name: lwm2m_notify_observer_path
methods.description: Notify an observer based on a specific object path.

methods.name: lwm2m_engine_get_next_attr
methods.description: Retrieve the next attribute in a sequence.

methods.name: lwm2m_engine_get_attr_name
methods.description: Get the name of a given attribute.

methods.name: clear_attrs
methods.description: Clear attributes associated with a reference.

methods.name: remove_observer_from_list
methods.description: Remove an observer from the list.

methods.name: engine_observe_node_discover
methods.description: Discover an observe node matching criteria.

methods.name: engine_remove_observer_by_token
methods.description: Remove an observer identified by token.

methods.name: engine_remove_observer_by_id
methods.description: Remove an observer by object and instance ID.

methods.name: lwm2m_engine_path_list_init
methods.description: Initialize a list of object paths.

methods.name: lwm2m_engine_add_path_to_list
methods.description: Add a new path to the list maintaining order.

methods.name: lwm2m_get_path_reference_ptr
methods.description: Get a reference pointer for a path.

methods.name: lwm2m_engine_clear_duplicate_path
methods.description: Remove duplicate paths when parent exists.

methods.name: lwm2m_obs_obj_path_list
methods.description: Retrieve the list of observation object paths.
